data.title: Profile
data.description: I'm a cloud and infrastructure architect with a 25-year engineering career that began in enterprise networking and progressed through DevOps, platform engineering and technical consulting into cloud architecture, with a sustained recent focus on Google Cloud — a year built around Anthos on Bare Metal, followed by a Kubernetes and container platform engagement at LSEG where roughly 80% of my time has been on GKE. At Endava I've also led the architecture of a secure, event-driven trading platform on GCP built around Pub/Sub and GKE, combining hands-on architectural ownership with mentoring and growing the engineering teams that deliver it. My background spans AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, giving me a working view of what migrations off those platforms actually involve, but Google Cloud is where I now concentrate. Most of my career has run through consulting engagements rather than a single in-house team, including at Devoteam, a Google Cloud partner, and I'm most effective owning the statement of work, standing behind the architecture, and defending it directly with senior client technologists.

Leading the design and delivery of cloud-native infrastructure solutions across major cloud providers. Combining hands-on technical architecture with strategic platform engineering, mentoring technical teams, and driving technical excellence in complex enterprise environments.

items.description: Architected a deterministic 14-stage agentic AI modernization pipeline (using Antigravity / agy) automating legacy COBOL reverse-engineering, domain modeling, service scaffolding, and test generation. Established human-in-the-loop governance with formal DAG-based verification gates requiring test-report validation and architectural signoff before releasing downstream dependencies. Integrated characterization and regression test harnesses guaranteeing AI-generated service code strictly preserved core business invariants while remediating legacy security flaws, and built an observability and workflow control tower capturing live execution transcripts, diff reviews, and audit trails across the automated delivery lifecycle.

Lead Cloud Architect delivering a secure trade messaging platform within GCP, utilising an event based architecture leveraging GCP PubSub and GKE while delivering isolated infrastructure to clients and partners.

Assigned to a long term consultancy role where I am leading the vision and delivery of Kubernetes and Container platforms across all major Cloud Providers.
Google Cloud was the primary platform for this work, with GKE accounting for roughly 80% of my time on the engagement against the other cloud providers combined.
Led development and execution of strategy for Kubernetes and Container platform teams, aligning with strategic business objectives, while improving productivity and developer experience both without and within.
Led, mentored and grew a high-performing global team, ensuring they had the resources and support needed to excel.
